leadRow.title: ASIC's misconduct data turns reporting channels into a control-intelligence test
leadRow.source: Primary / Australian Securities and Investments Commission / 2026-09-10

evidence.sourceTitle: 26-206MR Scams and governance failures dominate misconduct report | ASIC
evidence.significance: ASIC says retail-investor issues and governance matters made up more than four in five misconduct reports in the first half of 2026, with reports helping existing surveillance and investigations. The read-across is whether a firm can connect complaints, whistleblowing and scam intelligence to triage, investigation, accountable action and a record of the outcome.

sourceDateVerification.reason: ASIC's release record identifies 10 September 2026. The page exposes an unrelated 3 September metadata date to the generic extractor, so the date was checked directly against the primary release before publication.

leadRow.title: Elevated network errors for traffic routed between North America origins and SIN (Singapore) colo

evidence.sourceTitle: Elevated network errors for traffic routed between North America origins and SIN (Singapore) colo
evidence.significance: Cloudflare reported elevated network errors on traffic between North American origins and its Singapore location. The incident is a distinct technology-failure prompt: teams should test traffic routing, regional dependency assumptions, customer-impact detection and communications under cross-region degradation.

leadRow.title: CNIL turns e-invoicing platforms into a data-role and retention test
leadRow.source: Primary / Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés / 2026-09-10

evidence.sourceTitle: Facturation électronique : quels enjeux pour la protection des données personnelles ?
evidence.organisation: Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés
evidence.significance: CNIL's guidance accompanies the live French e-invoicing reform and sets out the practical boundary between controller and processor, the need for appropriate contracts, data minimisation, retention and platform traceability. For affected firms, the implementation question is whether the chosen platform's data use, access controls and audit record match the intended operating role.

sourceDateVerification.reason: The CNIL primary page displays 10 September 2026 beneath the headline. The feed timestamp resolves to the preceding UTC date, so the primary-page date was verified directly before publication.
